The '''LC-4''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Lhosan Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The LC-4 was introduced in the [[2015]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. It was released within the "Mid Rim Explorer's Pack" in patch 3.2.2.
